$schema-note: Lists of {name,value,usage}. CSS variables are prefixed --techrity-.
name: Techrity

meta.uiKit: Techrity web UI kit (Figma exports uploaded 22 Nov 2026): Color, Typography, Grid System, Grid layouts, Components, Pathway Card, Project overview, Label/View buttons, Dashboard header, Phosphor Icons

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page or slide background. Light for reading-heavy pages (reports, letters); purple for covers, section openers and social graphics.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface. #323232 on white is 12.8:1; white on purple is 8.9:1.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings and the wordmark on surface (8.9:1 both ways).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: addresses, captions, subtitles. 4.6:1 on white, 4.8:1 on purple.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one highlighted word in a headline (e.g. 'Brand Story', 'HUB'). Sky on purple is 4.9:1; on white the highlight falls back to purple because sky on white is only 1.8:1.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Divider rules, e.g. contents-list separators and the rule under a cover title.

tokens.name: brand-purple
tokens.usage: Official primary colour (Style Guide V1.0). Use it for slide grounds, the logo mark, headings and the disc behind icons. White text on it is 8.9:1. Some decks drift to #473d95; use #463a93.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Official primary colour (Style Guide V1.0). Use it for banner grounds, highlighted headline words on purple, and contour-line graphics. Purple text on it is 4.9:1 and black text 9.1:1. Never use it as text on white (1.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-lavender
tokens.usage: Official primary colour (Style Guide V1.0), used for the lavender logo and soft panels. White text on it is 4.0:1, so use it for text 24px and up only.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Official primary colour (Style Guide V1.0): the wordmark colour on blue, white and grey grounds. 16.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Observed in the letterhead footer panel, not in the style guide. White text on it is 4.6:1.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Observed in decks, not in the style guide: large subtitles on purple, as on the Year in Review cover. Flag: only 2.6:1 on brand-purple; prefer muted (#bfbbda) or brand-lavender.

tokens.name: lavender-tint
tokens.usage: The wave ribbon on white slides (brand-purple at 35% over white) and soft background shapes. Decorative only on white.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Letterhead header and footer bands. White text on it.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text and marks on purple, violet or black; the white logo on dark grounds.

tokens.name: ui-cyan
tokens.usage: Web UI action colour: primary buttons (Donate, Sign Up, Apply Now, View Full Story) and the filter pill. Always use dark text on it (neutral-10, 11.4:1); white text is only 1.5:1. A brighter UI version of brand-sky (#6dceef).

tokens.name: ui-gray
tokens.usage: Web UI card fill (the pathway card's default state). White text 7.8:1; ui-cyan numerals 5.2:1.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cover title, up to three lines.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Slide headline.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Line under a cover title, after a hairline rule.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Equal access to opportunities in tech for Africans.
styles.usage: Slide body copy. Don't go smaller; the decks favour large, readable text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Names, roles, credits.

styles.name: print-heading
styles.usage: Section heading in letters and forms.

styles.name: print-body
styles.sample: We confirm our acceptance of the terms of this appointment.
styles.usage: Letter body.

styles.name: print-footer
styles.usage: Contact block in the letterhead footer, white on black; the tagline uses the same size at weight 700.

styles.name: print-address
styles.sample: 48 Winners Avenue, Off Old OPM, Eneka Link Road, Port Harcourt
styles.usage: Address under the letterhead logo, in muted.

styles.name: lockup
styles.usage: Full-name lockup beside the mark on banners: all caps, wide tracking, brand-purple on brand-sky.

styles.name: ui-paragraph-xl
styles.sample: Every person should have a pathway from exposure to opportunity.
styles.usage: Paragraph Large (25px). Weights: Regular 400, Medium 500, Bold 700.

styles.name: ui-paragraph-lg
styles.sample: Every person should have a pathway from exposure to opportunity.
styles.usage: Paragraph Large (24px).

styles.name: ui-paragraph-md

styles.usage: Paragraph Medium (22px).

styles.name: ui-paragraph-md-sm

styles.usage: Paragraph Medium (20px).

styles.name: ui-paragraph
styles.sample: Coming from a non-traditional background, I struggled to break into tech.
styles.usage: Paragraph Regular (16px): the default body size.

styles.name: ui-paragraph-sm
styles.usage: Paragraph Small (12.8px / 13px): captions, meta, tags.

styles.name: ui-h1
styles.usage: Page hero title. Measured from the 1× UI kit export and rounded. Bold (700) by default; Black (900) for emphasis. The kit also shows a Semi-Bold column, but Now has no 600 weight, so use Medium (500) or Bold.

styles.name: ui-h2
styles.usage: Section title. Measured from the 1× UI kit export and rounded. Bold (700) by default; Black (900) for emphasis. The kit also shows a Semi-Bold column, but Now has no 600 weight, so use Medium (500) or Bold.

styles.name: ui-h3
styles.usage: Block or card-group title. Measured from the 1× UI kit export and rounded. Bold (700) by default; Black (900) for emphasis. The kit also shows a Semi-Bold column, but Now has no 600 weight, so use Medium (500) or Bold.

styles.name: ui-h4
styles.usage: Card title. Measured from the 1× UI kit export and rounded. Bold (700) by default; Black (900) for emphasis. The kit also shows a Semi-Bold column, but Now has no 600 weight, so use Medium (500) or Bold.

styles.name: ui-h5
styles.usage: Sub-section label. Measured from the 1× UI kit export and rounded. Bold (700) by default; Black (900) for emphasis. The kit also shows a Semi-Bold column, but Now has no 600 weight, so use Medium (500) or Bold.

styles.name: ui-h6
styles.usage: Small heading, overline. Measured from the 1× UI kit export and rounded. Bold (700) by default; Black (900) for emphasis. The kit also shows a Semi-Bold column, but Now has no 600 weight, so use Medium (500) or Bold.
